site.name: Guruprasad Karanam
site.intro: A collection of working demos — integration processes, real-time APIs and the web front ends that use them. Each project lives in its own folder under /projects.

projects.title: Copperleaf Provisions — Operations Portal
projects.summary: A sales and master-data portal for a fictitious fine-food wholesaler. Every screen is backed by Boomi real-time APIs that call the Northwind OData V2 service: a KPI dashboard with charts, orders with printable invoices, product order insight, customers, suppliers and employees.
highlights: 8 REST routes on one Boomi API Service, each a listener + testable subprocess
Dashboard process fans out to 11 OData queries with a Branch step
Hosted copy runs from a captured Boomi snapshot; runs live locally via a credential-holding gateway
